The '''Shot Caller''' was the nickname used by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] who commanded the [[Gauntlet (gang)|Gauntlet]] gang on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The criminal was killed when a Republic aligned individual attacked the gang in around [[3643 BBY]].
